scope.q: What types of websites and web applications do you build?
scope.a: Across the 8 core services, I build custom websites, responsive designs, interactive JavaScript/React applications, landing pages, redesigns, and UI/UX implementations.

hubs.q: Why are there two Project Hubs (Basic and Advanced)?
hubs.a: Both hubs are preserved as independent public archives: the Basic Projects Hub indexes 28 foundational builds in a lightweight layout, while the Advanced Projects Hub expands to 34 projects including Backend Phases 1–6 and visual previews.

stack.q: Which technologies do you primarily work with?
stack.a: Verified projects use HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, REST APIs, Git & GitHub, along with Node.js and Express.js backend learning phases.

process.q: How does a typical project collaboration start?
process.a: Share your goals, project type, timeline, and requirements via the Contact page or WhatsApp. We review the scope together, organize the layout and architecture, build iteratively, and refine across devices.

contact.q: What is the fastest way to reach you?
contact.a: You can submit the secured contact form on the Contact page, send a direct email to arslansahil850@gmail.com, or start a WhatsApp conversation directly.
